units.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

units.name: Scroll

protocol.summary: Pinned internal FW ae60717a; independent Scroll I2C slave, LE int32 counter, active-low button, RR/GG/BB bytes at 0x31..33, bounded TX snapshot loops. Selecting an increment register snapshots and clears before read. UIFlow low16 getters and Python-only setter offsets are preserved.

registers.reset: 0x40 value1 clears logical count/increment, not physical source
registers.increments: 0x50..53 LE int32; selection snapshots remaining suffix and clears
registers.direction: 0x60 physical TIM direction; 0xFB configured AB direction
registers.system: 0xFC bootloader flash read unsupported, 0xFE firmware version1, 0xFF address change; 0xFD bootloader transition unsupported

gaps: TIM16 rollover IRQ/NVIC reachability is not proven for pinned vendor source; source input is explicitly bounded.
RGB is a synchronous latest-value model for quiescent writes. The MCU multi-slot RGB queue, burst/slot-dependent partial writes and LED scheduling are not simulated.
No STM32 bootloader execution, persistent configuration Flash or mechanical angle mapping.
QEMU address-zero broadcast/unicast mismatch and address collision are rejected explicitly.

source-count.description: Synthetic electrical tick position; TIM16=0x8000+source-count. Single event delta at most 32767; timer rollover and signed counter overflow fail closed. This is separate from guest-writable counter and is not a mechanical angle.

units.name: FlashLight

protocol.summary: S1 selects FLASH/TORCH internally. EN pulses 1..8 encode 100..30% at nominal 220ms; 9..16 encode the same eight relative codes at nominal 1300ms. Torch EN high is steady on; long low >500us resets.
gaps: Recommended pulse envelope is qualification, not a claim other widths fail on silicon.
Torch EN PWM description conflicts with the datasheet FLASH-pin PWM path; no waveform model admitted.
Original UIFlow2 long-flash multiplication differs from Table 1.

flash-mode.label: Flash 模式（关闭为 Torch，仅创建时可选）

last-edge-ns.description: QEMU virtual nanoseconds; -1 means no pending/observed event.

first-rise-ns.description: QEMU virtual nanoseconds; -1 means no pending/observed event.

settle-at-ns.description: QEMU virtual nanoseconds; -1 means no pending/observed event.

timeout-at-ns.description: QEMU virtual nanoseconds; -1 means no pending/observed event.

edge-trace-ns.description: Bounded oldest-to-newest [QEMU virtual nanoseconds, actual EN pad level 0/1]. Reads across fields are not an atomic snapshot.

evidence.known_issue: brightness*time emits the wrong command for seven of eight 1300ms requests; retain original bytes as negative controls.

runtime.required_data_plane: Yellow EN SoC GPIO pad edges plus QEMU_CLOCK_VIRTUAL nanosecond timers; no duty-snapshot pulse synthesis.

units.blocker: Partial nominal digital model: only qualified GPIO bitbang HI/LO 750..10000ns and steady Torch. Last-rise+500us latch and first-rise+nominal deadline are explicit model policies. Guest and Web validation must bind the exact host/firmware/runtime; none is inherited from C tests.
